text:
Maria Chen: Quick heads-up — we’re onboarding Orchid-13B-ql to dedicated serving later today. Need to confirm weights path, a tokenizer oddity, and final continuous-batching + scheduler knobs before we flip traffic.

Alex R: weights are at gs://redwood-models/orchid/13b/2026-03-15/ — patchy sharded files but complete. run `gsutil ls gs://redwood-models/orchid/13b/2026-03-15/*` to double-check. :ok_hand: 

Samir: noted. did you hit the tokenizer issue (prefix off-by-one) that showed up on the test harness?

Maria Chen: yes — on the eval suite some prompts ended up with an extra <s> at the front causing prefix cache misses. Looks like the HF tokenizer config has `add_bos_token: true` for that fork. We should either strip BOS at ingest or set cache to ignore initial token.

Jordan: I recommend normalizing at tokenize-time. Add `strip_bos: true` in the model config to avoid cache fragmentation. Less risky than changing cache semantics.

Natalie: agree. small config patch incoming. Also, scheduler wise we need to avoid tail-latency regressions for 2k token requests. Current prod defaults: `max_batch_tokens=4096`, `batch_timeout_ms=25`, continuous prefix cache enabled. On Orchid we should lower batch_timeout and reduce max_batch_tokens because token distribution skews long.

Alex R: propose these tuned settings (minimal risk):
```json
{
  "batching.enabled": true,
  "batching.max_batch_tokens": 2048,
  "batching.batch_timeout_ms": 12,
  "batching.continuous.prefix_cache": "kv",
  "batching.continuous.max_prefix_len": 512,
  "scheduler.max_outstanding": 6,
  "scheduler.fairness_mode": "latency_weighted",
  "model.max_tokens": 1024
}
```

Samir: looks reasonable. For Orchids we saw steady-state throughput drop when max_batch_tokens > 3k on A100s for mixed seq lengths. Reducing to 2k removes spikes.

InfraBot: deploy checklist reminder — run `infra deploy check-model --name orchid-13b-ql --weights gs://redwood-models/orchid/13b/2026-03-15/ --config path` and attach PR.

Maria Chen: pinging @Alex R and @Natalie for quick review of PR #4782 (serving config + tokenizer strip). If both green, I’ll trigger canary with 5% traffic on dedicated pool.

Natalie: reviewed — left one nit (json field naming). Will push patch in 10m and lgtm after.

Alex R: lgtm after Natalie's nit. Also adding a short test to eval harness: 20 seeded prompts to ensure prefix cache hits > 85% within 3 requests.

Jordan: canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with metric checks on p50/p95 latency and cache hit rate. Auto-rollback if p95 increases > 15% or cache_hit drops > 10%.

Samir: logging note — add `tokenizer.strip_bos=true` to model metadata so downstream teams don’t reintroduce the discrepancy.

Maria Chen: thanks all. I’ll wait for Natalie's patch then kick off InfraBot command. Will post canary results here. :rocket:
